why: FKT describes Cathedral Pass, PCT, Peggy's Pond, SE ridge to the West Peak; WTA's Mount Daniel page describes the same Peggy's Pond ridge route ending in a few class 3 moves.
FKT goes trailhead to lookout and back; WTA describes the same trail to the summit lookout as the page's single main route.
FKT is the Sulphide Glacier route car to car; WTA confirms the Shannon Ridge trail is the approach climbers use for the Sulphide Glacier.
The page's GPS track is a Monitor Ridge file with a trailhead-summit-trailhead category, and WTA describes Ptarmigan Trail then Monitor Ridge to the rim from Climbers Bivouac.
FKT's primary route is Ingalls trailhead over Longs Pass up the Cascadian Couloir, and Wikipedia names the Cascadian Couloir as Stuart's standard route.

The FKT trail-to-summit scramble (steep forest, scree, meadow, ridge walk) is the single walk-up route from the Forest Road 2419 trailhead that WTA describes with exposed class 3-4 ridge walking, matching our standard scramble.
Both the FKT page and WTA take the Stafford Creek trailhead to Navaho Pass then the County Line trail up to the summit, which is our route's line.

The FKT loop traverses Painted to White Mountain and our route is that same traverse from the North Fork Sauk trailhead, exiting via White Pass and the Sauk trail, with a trip report confirming the line and White Mountain as the traditional finish.
The FKT is the Easy Pass round trip linking Mesahchie, Katsuk, Kimtah and Cosho, the same Ragged Ridge traverse our route describes, and a trip report confirms the line and Fisher Creek exit.
